verdict.rationale: Browser Use is explicitly designed around natural-language task input (e.g. 'Find the top Hacker News story', 'Fill in this job application with my resume and information'), with both cloud API and open-source library accepting plain-English goals and returning results, corroborated by community hands-on use. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of NL command reliability/accuracy across diverse tasks, and more detail on limits of NL command complexity.
